en: ■ －－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－ 　 B equipment of "Hunting the Immortal Bird",　 “ Ｖ ｅ ｒ ． K a" at the top. 　 －－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－ 　 In the MG "Ver.Ka" series, Narrative GUNDAM B equipment is now available. The backpack unique to B equipment is reproduced with a new model. 　　 ● Narrative GUNDAM B equipment is three-dimensional with "Ver.Ka" 　B equipment introduced in the "Phoenix Hunt" operation. Each gimmick of the wired remote attack terminal, which is the main weapon, is reproduced. 　 ・Backpack 　 The backpack is equipped with movable shafts in each part, and the remote attack terminal can reproduce the projectile position in the play without interfering with the shoulder of the aircraft. 　 ・Wired remote attack terminal 　 The wired remote attack terminal, which is the biggest feature of the B equipment, is equipped with a gimmick of pulling out a cable and winding it. 　The remote attack terminal reproduces the transformation from the normal form to the deployed state without replacing parts. 　 It is possible to wind the cable by lifting and turning the handle mounted on the backpack. 　 Using the included ACTION BASE and weapon display base, you can display Narrative GUNDAM B equipment and an ejected wired ranged attack device. 　 ・Small shield 　 The small shield is attached to the forearm. In addition, the joint parts on the back of the shield can be unfolded to connect two small shields. 　 ・Beam, Saber Rack 　 Narrative GUNDAM with a beam saber rack on the waist. 　 ● Comes with clear color psycho frame parts 　By painting the clear-colored psycho frame, it is possible to produce various states such as activation and awakening states. 　* The posted image is painted. 　　 ● Luxurious set contents 　 Includes ACTION BASE, weapon display base, and newly designed waterslide decals. 　 By using joint parts for C-equipped backpacks, it is possible to equip both C and B equipment with original equipment. 　 ● Newly drawn illustrations by Hajime Katoki, delivered in a full-color package. 　 Armament : B equipment set Accessories: Psycho Flame Runner (Clear) / Joint Parts for C-equipped Backpack / ACTION BASE / Weapon Display Base / Water Transfer Decals 　 －－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－ 　 1/100 Scale Assembled Plastic Model 　 Target age: 15 years old or older 　 Product material: PS, ABS, PET, PVC 　 ・No adhesive is used for assembly. 　 －－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－　 　　 * The finished product in the photo has been painted.
